newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX BRENT UNQUOTED, MARKET DIRECTIONLESS.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX BRENT UNQUOTED, MARKET DIRECTIONLESS.

text.p: September Brent futures were unquoted at midday on Tuesday, with the market at a loss for direction.
October Brent on SIMEX was offered at $18.80 per barrel, after October Brent on IPE closed 11 cents higher at $18.75.
But no other bids or offers were seen on SIMEX apart from that.
September Brent on IPE saw a slight rebound after falling for four consecutive days, closing 10 cents higher overnight at $18.58.
But brokers in in Singapore said that buyers were waiting for firmer prices before coming out.
They added that some players were also looking at the API statistics, due out late Tuesday in New York, for an idea of where prices would head.
NYMEX crudes on ACCESS last traded six cents higher than New York's $19.69, which had risen 15 cents per barrel.
